indicators.title: Guidance delivery
indicators.question: When management gave a number, did the reported figure land within it?
indicators.headline: Kept 4 of 6 explicit targets whose period has closed (FY25–FY26).
indicators.method: Closed explicit targets only. Kept = delivered or ahead; the ledger's tolerance applies. A rate needs at least 4 targets across 2 fiscal years.

indicators.title: Where results landed in the range
indicators.question: Does management guide conservatively, or tend to land short of the middle?
indicators.headline: Against the midpoint of the stated range, closed targets landed on the favourable side never, near it once and on the adverse side 4 times.
indicators.method: Ranges and 'around' figures only. Offset = actual - midpoint, in percentage points for growth and margins, and as a share of the midpoint for amounts. 'Favourable' depends on the metric: above the midpoint for growth, margins and capex; below it for credit cost and debt. Within 0.15 pp or 2% counts as at the midpoint. Counts are shown only from 4 targets across 2 years.

indicators.title: Guidance revisions
indicators.question: How often were targets changed mid-period, and in which direction?
indicators.headline: 1 of 10 explicit targets were changed before their period closed; 1 of those changes went against the company.
indicators.method: A revision is a later statement with a different number for the same metric and period. 'Against the company' means lowered for growth, margins and capex, raised for credit cost and debt. Two documents disagreeing in the same quarter are reported as a contradiction, not counted as a revision.
